visual_template.usage: Mandatory document/visual structure for PN images; physical dimensions are always target-project specific.
visual_template.side_view_dimension: Show only actual target-panel depth on the real lateral/depth axis; PN-AUT-001 current depth = 300 mm.
visual_template.brand_rule: No large manufacturer footer logos; technical manufacturer/model identification only where needed.

dimension_policy.rule: Do not use PN-AUT-001 cabinet dimensions as default dimensions for another PN.
dimension_policy.enclosure_selection: Derived from target LI/BOM, exact component geometry, mounting clearances, wiring/cable zones, thermal solution, maintenance space and frozen reserve.
dimension_policy.freeze_point: Selected enclosure and dimensions become authoritative only after target datasheet dimensional closure.

visual_template.dimension_conflict_resolution: PN-AUT-001 current project enclosure is 1200x800x300 mm. Any 1800 mm height image is stale and must be regenerated.
